pages.text: Although the original builders of the Mine Guardian can no longer be identified, you can command the souls of the dead to construct an Inactive Mine Guardian Block for you.
Place the Inactive Mine Guardian on the ground and right-click it with a Animation Core to spawn your Mine Guardian.
A created Mine Guardian comes with an anchor attached. You can cut it with Shears to allow it to float freely. If you want to tether it back, right-click your Mine Guardian while holding a Chain.
